content:
Black Friday 2026 is finally here. Although plenty of deals have gone live since the beginning of November, major retailers tend to save their absolute best sales for the core Black Friday time period starting Thanksgiving Day, running through Black Friday and the weekend, and ending on Cyber Monday. If you think you've seen the best that Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy, and other stores have to offer, then think again. Expect to see even deeper discounts on video games, 4K Blu-ray movies, consoles, electronics, Apple devices, and much more over the next few days.

This list will be updated throughout the entire Black Friday sale event, so check back for new deals.

The Best (and Only) Black Friday Gaming Console Deal

Save $50 off the official Black Friday Nintendo Switch 2 console bundle, which includes a copy of Mario Kart World and 3 months of Nintendo Switch Online membership. At this point, upgrading from the Switch to the Switch 2 is a no-brainer. Several Switch 2 exclusives have been released including Mario Kart World, Donkey Kong Bananza, Pokemon Pokopia, Kirby Air Riders, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, and more. Zelda: Ocarina of Time scored a 9/10 from IGN's Logan Plant.

Black Friday Streaming Services Deals

Black Friday is the best time of year to expand your streaming library. Premier streaming services like Disney + (and Hulu), HBO Max, Paramount Plus, and Crunchyroll have dropped subscription fees to the lowest prices of the year. Some of these deals only come around during Black Friday, so if you miss them, you'll have to wait until the tail end of 2027. If you're ready to catch up on the Marvel Avengers movies before Avengers: Doomsday releases, or check out the fantastic Avatar: Seven Havens animated TV series, or finally see why the Solo Leveling anime is so popular, the time is now.

The Best Black Friday Apple Deal: $100 Off AirPods Pro 3

The most popular Apple Black Friday deal just went live. If you're hunting for a pair of AirPods this holiday season, your wait is over. Amazon has just dropped the price of the AirPods Pro 3 - Apple's best earbuds - to just $149 with free shipping. This is a $100 price drop and easily the lowest price I've ever seen for Apple's newest generation AirPods Pro.

More Apple Deals

Apple watches, iPads, AirTags, MacBook laptops, even the iPhone Duo is discounted more on Black Friday than any other time of the year. If you're looking to upgrade your Apple devices, now is the time to do so.

Black Friday Deal: Beats Studio Pro Headphones Drops Below $100

Everyone's favorite high-end headphone is on sale at the lowest price ever. Walmart is offering the Beats Studio Pro wireless noise canceling headphones in two-tone white and black for just $99 with free shipping after a massive $200 off instant discount. This is the first time I've seen a brand new pair go for under $100. Beats is owned by Apple, and the Studio Pro is for people like myself who want a quality headphone but don't want to spend $400 on the AirPods Max. Also, the Beats Studio Pro works just as well paired with both iPhones and Android devices.

Black Friday Video Game Peripherals and Accessories

You'll generally need more than just a console and video games to maximize your enjoyment. Most accessories are completely unnecessary, but there are a few that you'll probably really appreciate down the road. These include extra storage expansion so you can fit more games, extra controllers for local multiplayer mayhem, and a carrying case to protect your console when you're on the move. All of these are on sale for Black Friday.

ABS Cyclone Aqua RTX 5060 Gaming PC for $749

Shopping around for a Black Friday gaming PC deal but restricted to a budget of under $1,000? Then check out this listing that recently popped up at Walmart. For a limited time, you can pick up an ABS Cyclone Aqua gaming PC equipped with a GeForce RTX 5060 graphics card for just $749 shipped. Despite the low price tag, this PC is still more powerful than the more expensive Steam Machine and will get you a consistent 60fps in most games at 1080p.

Audible Black Friday Deal: $0.99 Per Month + $20 in Audible Credit

New and previous subscribers

Don't miss out on Amazon's Audible Black Friday deal. Starting now and running through December 28, both Amazon Prime and non-Prime members can sign up for three months of Audible Standard for $0.99 per month. In addition to the discounted membership, you also get an extra $20 in Audible credit. This deal is valid for new and previous (currently expired) subscribers, however your mileage may vary (we noticed that some this deal doesn't show up for some account). Afterwards your subscription will convert to the standard $8.99/mo, but you can cancel the auto-renewal at any time.

Black Friday Video Game Deals

Nintendo Switch 2

PlayStation 5

Xbox Series X|S

If there's one thing we can be sure of on Black Friday, it's that there are going to be a ton of excellent video game deals. It doesn't matter whether you play on a Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, or Xbox console, you're going to find a game that you've been yearning to play at the lowest prices of the year (and in most cases, ever).

Black Friday TV Deals

Whether you're looking for the TV with the best image quality and you've got money to spend, or you've got a tight budget and value is paramount, Black Friday has got you covered. If you're planning to upgrade to OLED this year, you'll find a deal for it. If you're looking for something bigger, like a 75" or dare I say 100", you'll find a deal for that too.

The Best Black Friday Gaming PC Deals (Yes, They Exist)

Prices are at an all-time high for gaming PCs and components. If you want to upgrade your computer, you're going to have to bite bullet. Still, that doesn't change the fact that Black Friday is far and away the best time of year to save money, including PC hardware. Here are some solid Black Friday deals to help alleviate the financial sting of your PC purchase.

Black Friday Deal: 3-for-$33 4K Blu-rays on Amazon

More 4K Blu-ray Movies on Sale

Looking to fill out your 4K Blu-ray movie collection? In addition to having your favorite movies on hand instead of hoping one of the streaming services has it on current rotation, this is a big step towards cutting your reliance on monthly-based subscriptions in general. There are literally hundreds of movies that are on sale right now, especially when you stack Black Friday discounts with the ongoing 3-for-$33 4K Blu-ray sale on Amazon.

Black Friday LEGO Deals

It ain't Black Friday without a ton of LEGO deals for both kids and adult-sized kids alike. Whether you're interested in Pokemon, Harry Potter, Super Mario, Star Wars, or more, there is a themed LEGO set that's just ready to be worked on. Some of these sets have dropped to the lowest price ever, others have dropped in price for the first time since launch.

Black Friday Deal: Meta Quest 3S VR Headset

Bonus $49.51 Amazon credit

If you haven't experienced the world of immersive VR gaming, you're missing out. I've reviewed the Meta Quest and I'll be the first to admit that VR gaming isn't for everyone. That said, I wholeheartedly encourage any avid gamer to try it out, and the Meta Quest 3S is the most accessible way to do so. The 2026 Black Friday bundle includes GOLF+, the official VR golf game of the PGA TOUR, for $297, which is $53 less than its normal price. Amazon is sweetening the deal by throwing in an additional $49.51 in Amazon promotional credit, which is automatically applied to your cart.

The Asus ROG Flow Z13 Gaming Laptop Drops Below $2,000

For Black Friday, Amazon is offering the lowest price I've seen on ASUS' powerful ultraportable gaming convertible. You can pick up a brand new Asus ROG Flow Z13 gaming laptop with 32GB of RAM for just $1,699.99 with free shipping after a $400 off discount. The Asus Flow Z13 (in tablet mode) isn't much bigger or heavier than a handheld gaming PC, but it boasts way better gaming performance that rivals full-sized laptops.

Black Friday Alienware OLED Gaming Monitor Deals

Dell makes some of the best gaming monitors around under the Alienware brand. Its OLED monitors are no different. They source the same panels used in the highest end LG and Samsung OLED monitors and add on a 3 year warranty that covers OLED burn-in. For Black Friday, most of Dell's newest 2026 and 2025 monitors have dropped to new price lows. These include smaller sizes like the 27" Alienware AWAW2726DM to bigger sizes like the recently released 39" Alienware AW3926QW. Check out all the Black Friday deals below.

Black Friday Deal: Lenovo Legion Go S Z1 Extreme SteamOS Edition

Just like any other device that has RAM and storage, handheld gaming PC prices have risen in 2026. However, if you want to get into PC gaming, this is still the most accessible way without spending a small fortune. For Black Friday, Lenovo is offering a brand new Legion Go S AMD Ryzen Z1 Extreme SteamOS Edition handheld gaming PC for $849.99 with free shipping, no coupon code required. This handheld sells for $1,000 everywhere else.

Black Friday Noise Canceling Headphone Deals

It's about time you upgraded from your standard headphones to the noise canceling variety. Across the board, noise canceling headphones are more expensive than non-ANC variants, but it's worth it to be able to drown out the outside world and focus on pure, unadulterated music. Black Friday has historically been the best time of year to score the lowest prices on the highest-rated noise canceling headphones, and 2026 is no different.

Upgrade Your Home Theater During the Sonos Black Friday Sale

The official Sonos Black Friday Sale has kicked off with some massive discounts on nearly Sonos' entire audiophile lineup. That includes perennial favorites like the Arc Ultra soundbar, Era 100 smart speakers, Sub Gen 4 subwoofer, Ace headphones, Move 2 portable speaker, and more. If you're looking to upgrade your entire home theater setup, then this Black Friday sale can be your one stop shop.

The SteelSeries Black Friday Sale Offers Discounts of Up to 50% Off

The SteelSeries Black Friday Sale has kicked off in earnest. You can head over to the SteelSeries online store to catch the complete list of deals, but interestingly Amazon is offering lower prices on several of the items. This is a product-wide discount that slashes up to 50% off Steelseries' best gaming headsets, mice, keyboards, and controllers, dropping them to the lowest prices we've seen all year (and in some cases, ever).ee through Black Friday.

The IGN Deals team has over 30 years of combined experience finding the best discounts and preorders available online. If you want the latest updates from our trusted team, here’s how to follow our coverage:

Eric Song is the IGN commerce manager in charge of finding the best gaming and tech deals every day. When Eric isn't hunting for deals for other people at work, he's hunting for deals for himself during his free time.
